backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a Tetris backend with leaderboard score submission, mission management, and user profile storage, all protected by role-based access control (admin/user permissions).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two responsive layout features (NextPiecePreview repositioning and full mobile responsiveness) to their affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of every frontend source file, serving as a reference for the project's component and hook architecture.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the TetrisVerse React app, setting viewport meta, page title, and mounting the root div with the main TSX module.
frontend/public/app-ads.txt: Google AdMob app-ads.txt authorization file declaring a direct relationship with the publisher ID pub-7936595519986908.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing screen navigation between menu, game, leaderboard, missions, and settings, wrapping the app in theme, language, audio, and React Query providers.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright, an app-ads.txt link, a privacy policy link, and a caffeine.ai attribution, styled dynamically using the current game theme.
frontend/src/components/GameBoard.tsx: Main game screen component with a responsive layout that stacks the Next Pieces panel and stats above the canvas on mobile and uses a sidebar layout on desktop, with dynamic cell size calculation based on viewport dimensions.
frontend/src/components/GameCanvas.tsx: Renders the Tetris game board, grid lines, placed cells, ghost piece, active piece, and a pause overlay onto an HTML canvas element using the current theme and cell size.
frontend/src/components/GameOverDialog.t: Modal dialog shown at game end displaying final score, lines, and level stats, with a score submission form that posts the player's name and score to the leaderboard API.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: App-wide header with logo/home navigation, leaderboard and missions links, a language selector dropdown, mute toggle, and a settings navigation button.
frontend/src/components/LandingPage.tsx: Static marketing/developer landing page for TetrisVerse that displays AdMob verification info, publisher ID, and a link to the app-ads.txt file.
frontend/src/components/Leaderboard.tsx: Leaderboard screen that fetches and displays top scores per game mode, with mode-tab filtering, rank icons for top 3, and formatted submission dates.
frontend/src/components/MainMenu.tsx: Main menu screen showing the TetrisVerse logo and navigation buttons for Play, Leaderboard, Missions, and Settings, styled with the active theme.
frontend/src/components/MissionNotificat: Displays temporary toast-style notifications in the top-right corner when a 'missionComplete' custom event fires, auto-dismissing after 4 seconds with a close button.
frontend/src/components/MissionsPanel.ts: Renders a full-page missions list with overall progress bar, showing each mission's completion status, progress toward goal, and reward, loaded from localStorage or defaults.
frontend/src/components/ModeSelector.tsx: Modal overlay that displays all available game modes in a grid with icons, difficulty labels, and score multipliers, allowing the user to select a mode or close the dialog.
frontend/src/components/NextPiecePreview: Canvas-based component that renders a preview of upcoming Tetris pieces, supporting both vertical stacking and horizontal side-by-side layouts with gradient-styled cells.
frontend/src/components/SettingsPanel.ts: Full-page settings screen providing controls for audio mute toggle, theme selection, and language selection, persisted via their respective contexts.
frontend/src/components/TouchControlButt: Mobile-only touch control overlay rendering rotate, hard drop, left, soft drop, and right buttons with pointer-event debouncing to prevent duplicate inputs.
frontend/src/contexts/GameThemeContext.t: Defines and exports a collection of named game themes (neon, retro, minimal, space, ocean, candy, etc.) with color palettes, background images, and music files, along with a React context for managing the active theme.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Defines supported languages and their full translation maps for all UI strings, and provides a React context for managing the active language selection.
frontend/src/contexts/TetrisAudioContext: Wraps the useTetrisAudio hook in a React context provider, exposing the audio system to the component tree via useTetrisAudioContext and a backward-compatible useTetrisAudio alias.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, initializing access control with an admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useGameLogic.ts: Implements the core Tetris game logic hook, including board state, piece movement/rotation with SRS wall kicks, line clearing, scoring, and support for multiple game modes (classic, puzzle, insanity, etc.).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flows, identity persistence, and exposing login status flags to the component tree.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching top leaderboard scores and submitting new scores via the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTetrisAudio.ts: Implements a Web Audio API-based audio system hook that handles mute state, lazy-loading and caching of sound effect buffers, and looping background music playback.
frontend/src/hooks/useTouchControls.ts: React hook that translates touch events (tap, swipe) into Tetris game actions like rotate, move, and hard drop, with configurable thresholds and interactive element exclusion.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining Tailwind base/components/utilities, CSS custom properties for a dark neon game theme, and utility classes for glow animations and scanline effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/types/game.ts: Defines TypeScript types and constants for all game modes, tetromino shapes, board dimensions, and game state structure used throughout the Tetris application.
frontend/src/types/missions.ts: Defines the MissionData interface and a DEFAULT_MISSIONS array containing eight predefined in-game missions with goals, rewards, and progress tracking across various game modes.
frontend/src/utils/color.ts: Provides two utility functions: adjustBrightness for modifying hex color brightness and safeColor for safely returning a color value with fallback handling.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence helpers and a function to clean sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with CSS-variable-based colors for a neon game UI, custom game fonts, border radii, and keyframe animations like glow-pulse and float.
project_state.json: Tracks the TetrisVerse project state at version 9, documenting architectural notes, known issues, existing features, and a summary of the rebuild goals including all game modes, themes, sounds, i18n, mobile layout, AdMob, and PWA support.
